g.text: AoiRank6Convo3 begins.
sooooo question
u have a spaceship
And?
I have a few, actually.
I do. :)
how does it get between planets?
<RETRO_EMOJI_PASSGLASSES>
do u have... super rockets? worm holes? how do u cover the big distances?
<RETRO_EMOJI_YUM>
<RETRO_EMOJI_SUNGLASSES>
solar sails? my parents were trying to figure out how to do it
<RETRO_EMOJI_STARE>
+5 Chemistry
You're not going to like the answer. The Orokin built the solutions.
Well, that depends. Do you mean my "big ship" or my "little ship?"
anyway...
lol ^_^ but like
<RETRO_EMOJI_ANNOYED1>
+5 Chemistry
how do they go between planets?
well... i guess no society is all bad
<RETRO_EMOJI_WHOA>
how does it work?
both!!! start with the big ship first!!
Well, it depends on if it's the big ship or the little ship - but they both tap into the Void to cross the big distances. They cross through the Void.
Well, that's my Railjack. It has a replica of the severed finger of the Indifference - known as the Reliquary Drive - in it.
The big ship, the Railjack, uses a thing called a Reliquary Drive - it has a replica of the severed finger of the Indifference in it.
It uses that to tap into the Void to cross the big distances between the planets. It goes through the Void.
<RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>
i'm sorry
wat
RL;CBA: Albrecht went into the Void, panicked, wound up stealing some of the Indifference's fingers.
Well. Okay. So. Albrecht... was the first person to "discover" how to get into the Void.
first... RL;CBA:?
It was a diving bell, of sorts. Made of something called seriglass. He stretched open the membrane between the worlds.
Real Long; Can't Be Arsed. Quincy taught it to me.
Things went... wrong, to put it lightly. He panicked, staggered, the thing tipped, it got knocked against the razor-sharp edge of the membrane.
huh...
The seriglass bell shattered and he fell into the Void.
second
And when he came to, he was back in his lab, only it wasn't his lab. And he was staring at himself. Only it wasn't himself. And "he" called himself a name only his mother would know.
****U HAVE ITS FINGERS?!?!?!****
So, Albrecht ran for his life. He cut himself up on the broken seriglass, and wrote in his own blood for his daughter to close the membrane behind him -
AND U USE IT TO POWER YOUR RAILJACK?!?!
- because he could feel that the "man" was reaching for him.
<RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>
She did. And when it shut? Well... its fingers were cut off, lying on the floor.
maybe that's y it's mad!!!
It powers a lot more than just the Railjack, that's the problem...
Probably.
first: incredible story...
oh...
can't u just give them back?!
second
I... don't know where they are.
I don't know if that's a good idea?
but they were stolen...
Even if we knew where they were, I don't know if we *should* give them back.
I know. I don't feel right about it, either.
what do u mean?
But unfortunately, the damage is done. Albrecht took the fingers. And now there's no going back.
There's something about the "Strands of Khra." It's super complicated? Something about it... I don't know?
I don't know if giving them back would do any good. I don't think it'd change his mind.
Binding it here? Keeping it on our playing field? We have its fingers, so its stuck playing by our rules.
I think the damage is done.
.... i don't like any of this
space travel was supposed to be... fun. cool. full of... exploration, and meeting new species
boldly going somewhere idk amir has a whole speech from one of his shows
but it was supposed be about... humanity and empathy and learning and adventure
not... this
You never know, I suppose. Time will tell.
Sometimes I wonder if that isn't what Entrati was doing, sending me back here. With all of you.
<RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>
Or off to wherever, to help... fix people.
yea, it will, 1 way or another
Even if it is to clean up his messes, in a way, it's to bring exactly that to the universe. That empathy you're talking about.
So, do you want to hear about the solar rails next?
But I can only hope that in the end, that's what this is all about. And that I'm not chasing around after a madman with a mop bucket.
lol no
+5 Chemistry
Chat ends.
well if thats what ur doing, i'll be right there with u!
<RETRO_EMOJI_TWOHUGS>
mop twinssss lol
but... i hope ur right. i hope that in the end, this is about rebuilding what we've lost
otherwise, what's the point?
